name: 33406 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33406 (West Palm Bch) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33406 (West Palm Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
